_why: ADR 0057's mutation table, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
CONTRIBUTING told contributors to run `make test` before opening a PR.
That is 2 of the 11 steps in CI's `test` job; across the workflow, 1 of
18 run-steps appeared in any Makefile recipe. `make guards` and
`make pr` closed it and this guard keeps it closed.
C6 is the row that escaped the original hand-run table. Counting
unclassified CI steps as reachable removes the guard's entire purpose,
and all eight tests accepted it -- because the repository was clean at
the time, so main() returned 0 either way. Every test agreed with a
guard that had stopped guarding. The fix was to extract classify() so
a test could hand it a step with no local route.

mutations.description: a CI step exempted with an empty reason
mutations._note: 'CI only' without a reason is how a step nobody can reproduce becomes permanent by default.
mutations.find:
"corepack prepare pnpm": (
        "Toolchain activation. `make doctor` reports whether pnpm is "
        "present and prints this exact command as the fix."
    ),

mutations.description: the workflow parser silently returns nothing
mutations._note: A hand-rolled reader that returns [] makes the guard report 'all clear' on a repository it never examined. The floor exists for exactly this.

mutations.description: normalisation collapses every command to one string
mutations._note: The failure mode of a fuzzy matcher is matching everything: every CI step would then appear covered by any recipe at all.

mutations.description: a stale CI_ONLY entry matching no step is tolerated
mutations._note: If CI drops a step, a leftover exemption silently covers the next step whose text happens to contain that substring.

mutations.description: an exemption also counts as locally runnable
mutations._note: CI-only and reachable are different facts. Merging them lets `make pr` quietly stop running something while the guard still reports it handled.

mutations.description: unclassified CI steps are counted as reachable
mutations._claimed: 1 failed (NOT caught before classify() was extracted)
mutations._note: The escape. This removes the guard's whole purpose and was invisible to all eight of its original tests, because the repository was clean so the return value was 0 regardless.
